info.prompt: Hauntingly beautiful still of **HEIST CASINO** climax — the **shared vault** pulses at **5000 points** as **70% of scored tiles** funnel into its **neural core**, while the thief’s **energy meter** hits **50/300** to initiate the heist. Other players scramble to block: **Rainmaker** extends the **five-second window** with **magenta time dilation**, **Headhunter** claws back **15% vault points**, and **Conductor**’s **10% contribution boost** flares in **amber streaks**. The **vault split (0.70)** is visualized as **liquid gold siphoned into arterial crimson**, all framed by **skeletal gold filigree** and **void black negative space**.
